proposal.hypothesis: A bounded one-way SSE2 scan of complete 16-byte blocks may improve on the prior prefix hybrid by locating the first high-bit lane within the first mixed block and starting the strict scalar decoder there, avoiding its scan of preceding ASCII bytes. All skipped bytes are ASCII, so this remains a known code-point boundary; the high-bit byte itself is still validated by the scalar decoder. The effect is input-dependent and must be measured on the official mixed-width n=65536 workload.

retained: Extracted the existing strict scalar UTF-8 decoder into a helper used for the suffix and for builds without SSE2.
Added a bounded SSE2 scan over complete 16-byte blocks, skipping only blocks whose high-bit mask is zero.
For the first mixed block, located the first high-bit byte and handed that byte and the remaining suffix to strict scalar validation; bounded vector loads and tail handling by length.
